messages:
Maya Chen: Quick ask — were running a rapid 3-day drip for the Nov mini-benchmark + webinar. Need social schedule, two hero images, and a seedlist by EOD. Who owns ops + creative?
Oliver Grant: Ops can schedule. Plan: Day 0 tease (short clip), Day 1 deep benchmark + LI long-form, Day 2 follow-up with quote cards. Stagger times for NA/EU/APAC buckets.
Sofia Ruiz: Ill write copy and two headline variants (Cost-first / Latency-first). Recommend A/B test on X root posts, keep LI as long-form anchor.
Caleb Turner: Seedlist: will export segmented CSV (enterprise PMs, infra leads, indie devs). Will add a "preferred contact" flag and timezone. Drive link soon.
Tess Nguyen: Engagement playbook ("short"): 1) monitor first 4 hours, 2) mark pricing or scale asks as high-intent, 3) SDR follow-up within 12h for APAC, 24h NA. I'll prep reply macros.
Maya Chen: CTA = "Reserve a seat" + registration https://redwood.ai/nov-mini. UTMs: utm_campaign=novmini2025&utm_medium=social&utm_source={twitter|linkedin|employee}&utm_content={variant}
